sara: Heads-up — AcmeOps (trial acct) reports ~40k credits gone overnight. They run background embedding batches and saw a huge spike around 2026-11-03T02:14Z. Can someone triage?

josh: On it. Can you paste the job ids + user id and any logs?

sara: user_id: acct-acme-123, job_ids: 0x8a3f2,0x8a3f3,0x8a3f4. Logs: see snippet below. Looks like multiple workers started the same job after a 500. :eyes:

```
[2026-11-03T02:13:59Z] worker=embed-1 job=0x8a3f2 status=500 error=UpstreamTimeout
[2026-11-03T02:14:00Z] scheduler enqueue job=0x8a3f2 retry=1 idempotency_key=null
[2026-11-03T02:14:00Z] worker=embed-2 job=0x8a3f2 started
[2026-11-03T02:14:00Z] worker=embed-1 job=0x8a3f2 started
[2026-11-03T02:14:01Z] worker=embed-3 job=0x8a3f2 started
```

josh: That smells like re-enqueue without dedupe — multiple workers executing same job => duplicate embeddings calls => credits multiply. Li, any recent changes to scheduler or enqueue path?

li: We have client-side idempotency for public API calls (idempotency header) but internal scheduler dedupe is by job_id metadata. I just checked deploy history: yesterday's scheduler change (deploy 2026-11-02 23:40) accidentally removed attaching job_id on the error/retry path. So when a worker fails we requeue but lose the id, so dedupe doesn't fire.

ashley: Customer is on the phone and pretty upset. Trial balance dropped from 100k -> ~58k in 30m. They want explanation + refund.

billing-bot: @ashley I can provisionally grant 50,000 credits to acct-acme-123. Confirm if you want me to apply now.

mike: Patch plan: revert the scheduler change on the error path, add server-side dedupe by job-hash (defense in depth), and throttle re-enqueue to 1 attempt per job per minute. Pushing a hotfix to staging now.

sara: Repro steps I used for local repro (shared so eng can reproduce):

1) Create background job to batch embeddings with chunk_size=512
2) Set env to force upstream 500: FAIL_EMBED_UPLOAD=1
3) Start 8 workers with concurrency=8 (matches prod for this customer)
4) Trigger the job and watch workers re-enqueue without idempotency header:

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood/v1/embeddings \
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-TRIAL' \
 -d '{"input":["..."], "idempotency_key": null}'
```

Observed behavior: many concurrent workers pick up the same work unit within the same second, each making an embeddings request -> massive credit duplication.

josh: I'll cut a hotfix to reattach job_id before enqueue on error and add a short-term mutex on the scheduler to prevent duplicate starts. Also adding a metric: jobs.dedupe.misses.

ashley: Please escalate to CS lead — customer wants an interim refund and a postmortem. They're on a call tomorrow at 15:00 PST.

billing-bot: Provisional credit 50,000 applied to acct-acme-123. Will reconcile after RCA.

ingest-bot: Sentry: SENTRY-EMBED-FANOUT-111 linked. Recent commits touching scheduler: commit a1b2c3 (2026-11-02 23:37), deploys: 3 in last 24h.

sara: Thanks team. Mike — can you share the rollback patch link here when ready? Will update customer thread and confirm credits. :thumbsup:

mike: Patch PR: https://git.redwood/p/scheduler/pulls/142 — rolling to prod in 5m with canary + monitoring.

sara: Nice. Will follow up with the customer and include repro steps + credits note. :heart:
